sn_aia_tool.description: Appends EXACTLY ONE internal work note to the engagement request. Journal-only by construction: the script can only write the work_notes journal and mechanically enforces the [AI Triage Draft] prefix. Inputs: request_sys_id, draft_text.
sn_aia_tool.input_schema: [{"name":"request_sys_id","description":"sys_id of the engagement request record (from the objective text)","mandatory":true},{"name":"draft_text","description":"The triage draft note (no prefix; the tool adds [AI Triage Draft])","mandatory":true}]
sn_aia_tool.name: PTAG - Append triage work note
